title: Expand model index with streaming hints, function-call metadata and pricing signatures
author: Priya Mehta
release_notes: Add new optional fields to model listing: supports_streaming, streaming_recommendations, supports_function_calls, function_call_schema_hint, openai_compatibility_level, pricing_per_1k_tokens, max_context_tokens. Backwards compatible; clients should ignore unknown fields.
description: Motivation: Clients need richer signals from the model index to make routing and UI decisions without probing instances. This change adds explicit capability flags and lightweight stability/practical hints for streaming and function/tool calling so SDKs, the console, and routing logic can choose conservative defaults and present correct UI affordances. Summary of changes: 1) API: extended /v1/models and protobuf schema with optional fields: supports_streaming (bool), streaming_recommendations (object encoded as JSON string with keys recommended_chunk_size, max_concurrent_streams, graceful_close_delay_ms), supports_function_calls (bool), function_call_schema_hint (string, compact JSON Schema or type hint), openai_compatibility_level (enum: none/basic/compat), pricing_per_1k_tokens (string, e.g. "0.004USD"), max_context_tokens (int as string). Fields are optional and default to conservative values when absent. 2) Runtime: compatibility shim updated to map OpenAI-style function-calling metadata into function_call_schema_hint so the SDK OpenAI-compat layer can automatically populate function signatures for client-side validation. 3) SDKs & Docs: updated TypeScript and Python SDK types and the model index docs page with examples and migration notes. 4) Tests: added e2e surface tests for model listing, unit tests for mapping logic, and flaky-test guard for streaming backpressure behavior. Implementation notes: - server/api/models.go: adds new fields to model listing serialization, uses best-effort probes to populate streaming_recommendations from runtime profile metadata. - api/proto/models.proto: schema bump (v1->v1+), maintains backwards-compat. - runtime/compat/mapping.go: logic to synthesize function_call_schema_hint from model metadata and to set openai_compatibility_level. - docs/api/model-index.md: exhaustive examples including the new streaming_recommendations payload. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag (model_index_capability_enrichment). Flag enabled for canary, then 50% of traffic for 48h, then global. SDKs will gracefully ignore new keys; Console will progressively enable richer UI when the flag is at 100%. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes — new fields are optional. Migration: customers using strict JSON mapping should update SDKs to accept extra fields; recommend using the new pricing_per_1k_tokens field for billing UI instead of scraping model name. CI and validation: added schema compatibility checks and a lightweight integration test that validates a limited set of models expose either none or safe defaults for these fields. Security/Privacy: no model inference data is exposed; all fields are metadata-only. Related items: ENG-4102 (model catalog enhancements), PM-187 (console cost UX).
